_comment: Copy to the path `resolve-bridge paths` prints as default_config_file, or run `resolve-bridge init`. Get your project id from `resolve-bridge doctor`. Relative paths resolve against this file's folder. Omit journal_path and backup_dir to use the per-user state folder. Set write_timeline_prefix to "" to allow timeline writes outside AI_BRIDGE_TEST_ timelines. midi_roots lists the only folders the MIDI tools may read; empty refuses every MIDI path. calibrated_builds: see docs/RECALIBRATION.md.
